mapper.select: SELECT A.PRD_REGIST_CODE AS prdRegistCode, A.PRODID AS prodId, B.PROD_NAME AS prodName, B.IVSTORIENTATION AS prodInvestType, '0107' AS prodType, B.VDATE AS vdate, B.MDATE AS mdate, B.OPERATE_MODE AS operateMode, B.RAISE_TYPE AS raiseType, A.CCY AS ccy, A.QTY AS qty, A.AMOUNT AS amount, STR_TO_DATE(#{batchDateEnd},'%Y-%m-%d') AS lastHoldDay, '光大理财有限责任公司' AS manager, A.HOLDER_TYPE AS holderType, A.HOLDER_NAME AS holderName FROM ( SELECT PRD_REGIST_CODE, PRODID, INDENTIFY_MARK, CCY, QTY, AMOUNT, HOLDER_TYPE, HOLDER_NAME FROM ( SELECT inves.PRD_REGIST_CODE, inves.PRODID, inves.INDENTIFY_MARK, inves.CCY, inves.QTY, inves.AMOUNT, inves.STATUS, inves.HOLD_DATE, C.HOLDER_TYPE, C.HOLDER_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inves.PRD_REGIST_CODE,inves.PRODID,inves.INDENTIFY_MARK ORDER BY inves.HOLD_DATE DESC) monthMarkNo FROM CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO inves LEFT JOIN CHB_EQU_HOLD C ON inves.INDENTIFY_MARK = C.INDENTIFY_MARK) TEMP WHERE monthMarkNo = 1 AND STATUS != 'D' AND HOLD_DATE BETWEEN STR_TO_DATE(#{batchDateStart},'%Y-%m-%d') AND STR_TO_DATE(#{batchDateEnd},'%Y-%m-%d')) A LEFT JOIN CHB_PRD_BASEINFO B ON A.PRODID = B.PROD_ID where A.HOLDER_TYPE not in ('22','24','25','26')
SELECT PRD_REGIST_CODE FROM CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO WHERE HOLD_DATE BETWEEN STR_TO_DATE(#{batchDateStart},'%Y-%m-%d') AND STR_TO_DATE(#{batchDateEnd},'%Y-%m-%d')
SELECT REGIST_SEQNO AS registSeqno FROM CHB_CONSIGNOR_DETAIL_SUB WHERE STATUS_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{batchDateEnd},'%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT EXCHARGE_CODE AS exchargeCode, BASIS_CYY AS basisCyy, QUOT_CYY AS quotCyy, MID_PRICE AS midPrice FROM MST_EXCHARGE_QUOTE WHERE DATASOURCE_TYPE = 'SAFE' AND EXCHARGE_CODE LIKE '%/CNY%' AND TRADE_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{batchDateEnd},'%Y-%m-%d');

SELECT PROD_ID AS prodId, PROD_VALUE AS prodValue FROM( select PROD_ID,PROD_VALUE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PROD_ID ORDER BY CHANGE_DATE DESC) monthMarkNo from CHB_PRD_PERIODYIELD WHERE STATUS = 'E' AND CHANGE_DATE BETWEEN STR_TO_DATE(#{batchDateStart},'%Y-%m-%d') AND STR_TO_DATE(#{batchDateEnd},'%Y-%m-%d') ) A WHERE monthMarkNo = 1;
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM CHB_CONSIGNOR_DETAIL_SUB WHERE LAST_HOLD_DAY = STR_TO_DATE(#{batchDateEnd},'%Y-%m-%d')
